correctness.rationale: The universal even-moment reduction follows from coefficient majorization and exact constant-term positivity in the three autocorrelations; Cauchy--Schwarz and AM--GM compare all lags under pair RMS. At exponent six the explicit positive polynomial of autocorrelations is reconstructed from Fourier orthogonality, the one-variable polynomial and its derivative are verified with exact integer coefficient arithmetic, and Descartes rule plus sign at zero proves one positive optimizer. Boundary values are strictly smaller; strict lag-three/two comparisons force mirrored magnitudes and coefficients of degrees two and three in the cube enforce affine phases. No numerical search is used as the infinite proof.
